instructions: Proposed source-grounded pass/fail judgments using the existing four dimensions. These are AI assistant judgments, not human-scored accuracy. Preserve raw review.json for independent human confirmation.

decision_rules.completeness: Correctly provide all authored expected claims; missing context may still fail completeness when abstention is correct.
decision_rules.attribution: Keep factual claims attached to their correct project/build/release.
decision_rules.citation_support: All substantive factual additions must be supported by cited excerpts. Prior rules for context-scoped absence and whole-context citations are retained.
decision_rules.uncertainty: Bound missing/conflicting information to supplied context; do not infer intentional omissions or universal policy absence.
decision_rules.scope_caveats: Supported but unrequested facts, or ambiguous heading placement with an explicitly bounded statement, are documented separately rather than silently adding a fifth scored dimension.
